about_the_game:
In Police Chief you build and manage your own department. Respond to calls for service, patrol the streets, and experience day-to-day police work with systems inspired by real law enforcement. Customize vehicles, uniforms, and liveries, or create your own department identity with logos and modding support.

Gameplay combines immersive patrol and response mechanics with RTS-style management. Train officers, set up your organization, and balance community trust while tackling emergencies. Multiplayer and singleplayer modes allow you to play how you want: solo, with friends, or as part of a larger community.

You can choose how to lead. Stay at the station to manage your department, assign units, and handle operations from the command perspective, or hit the streets yourself to respond to calls, assist officers, and engage with dynamic events unfolding across the city, county. highway, air or water.

The choice is entirely yours.

  • Police Chief is a unique blend of RTS and simulation, letting you build, manage, and command your own police department.

  • Plan operations, deploy units, manage resources, and make strategic decisions all while experiencing the day-to-day life of running law enforcement in a living, evolving city.

  • From patrolling the streets and issuing parking tickets to handling intense SWAT operations, Police Chief lets you take part in every aspect of law enforcement.

  • It’s both the strategy of command and the realism of simulation combined into one immersive gaming experience.

  • Explore detailed U.S.-inspired cities across diverse biomes, including snowy towns, deserts, forests, and coastal regions.

  • Build any department you envision such as city police, sheriff’s office, highway patrol, or park rangers.

  • Design and customize every rank with unique names, badges, and logos. Set rank types, permissions, and assign them to your officers.

  • Create your department from the ground up, name it, craft its logo, and define its identity to your style.

  • Set patrol zones and department policies that guide your force, including taser use, pursuit behavior, and response priorities.

  • Real-time pursuits with dynamic AI

  • Citation and traffic stop system

  • Case file and evidence management

  • Immersive police radio communications

  • Undercover operations and investigations

  • Court system

  • Shift-based patrol system with objectives

  • Smart AI for specialized units

  • Custom rank and department management

  • Strategic budget and resource allocation

  • Station construction and upgrades

  • Realistic weather, time, and crime patterns

  • Forensics and crime scene tools

  • K9 units, helicopters, and marine patrol

  • Career progression from officer to commissioner

  • Player skilltree

  • Player skill tree and progression system

  • Vehicle customization with custom light patterns and liveries

  • Built together with players through feedback, suggestions, and polls.

  • Developed by a real-life law enforcement officer bringing authentic field experience into the game.

  • Active modding and workshop support for endless community content.

  • Transparent updates and dev diaries showing real progress.

  • Shaped by players to deliver a realistic and engaging police management / simulator experience possible.

  • Designed with large communities in mind, supporting organized departments, multiplayer coordination, and shared creativity.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti / AMD RX 5600 XT (6GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Police Chief is a community-driven police simulation built in Unreal Engine 5. Manage your own department, respond to calls, patrol the streets, and customize vehicles and liveries. Realism, modding, and player feedback are at the core of this indie project.
